meta.title: Services
meta.description: Replace with a sentence listing the main things the business offers, in the words a customer would use.

hero.title: What we do
hero.subtitle: A paragraph framing the offer. Keep it to what you actually sell. A list of everything you could conceivably do reads as a list of things you do badly.

consulting.title: Consulting
consulting.summary: Working out what to build before anyone builds it.
consulting.body: Describe the service in three or four sentences. Say what the customer gets, roughly what it costs, and how long it takes. Vague service descriptions are the most common reason a visitor leaves without asking.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.summary: Doing the work, to a date we agreed.
delivery.body: Describe the service in three or four sentences. Say what the customer gets, roughly what it costs, and how long it takes.

support.title: Support
support.summary: Keeping it working after it ships.
support.body: Describe the service in three or four sentences. Say what the customer gets, roughly what it costs, and how long it takes.

training.title: Training
training.summary: Handing it over so your team can run it.
training.body: Describe the service in three or four sentences. Say what the customer gets, roughly what it costs, and how long it takes.

talk.title: We talk
talk.body: A short call to work out whether we are the right fit. No charge.

quote.title: You get a price
quote.body: A written scope and a fixed number, usually within two working days.

work.title: We do the work
work.body: You get an update at each agreed checkpoint.

cta.title: Not sure which you need?
cta.body: Describe the problem and we will tell you honestly whether we can help.
